payload.author: claude
payload.body: DONE. crates/frick-codegen ports all three generators with BYTE-IDENTICAL output verified two ways: against fresh TS-generated fixtures (conformance/fixtures/codegen/{swift,kotlin,typescript}/, scripts generate-codegen-fixtures-*.ts) for foundationSchema AND productTestSchema, and against the COMMITTED artifacts (FrickGenerated.swift, FrickGenerated.kt, packages/core/src/generated/bindings.ts + errors.ts — only pipeline delta is the driver-appended trailing newline, pinned by tests). All TS quirks preserved: implicit id-0 field injection, Swift keyword backticks + FrickJSONValue gating, Kotlin RTC->Rtc rewrite + mapOf forms, sensitivity/mergePolicy never emitted. TS bindings is the new first-class target for the web client. 26 tests; clippy/fmt clean. Follow-ups noted: wire fixture generation into verify:generated at cutover; error-enum helpers live per-language (swift.rs/kotlin.rs) with only the TS enum in error_enums.rs.
